title: Found an AI Pine Script generator
author: Jealous_Win2699
selftext:
For anyone experimenting with Pine Script, I came across an AI tool that generates TradingView Pine Script from natural-language strategy descriptions.

It can handle things like:

* Indicators
* Entry / exit conditions
* Stop loss / take profit
* Alerts
* Strategy logic

[https://tradingviewai.dev/](https://tradingviewai.dev/)

Obviously the generated code still needs to be reviewed and backtested, but it seems useful for getting a prototype running quickly.

Has anyone here tried something similar?
